Anthony Fenech

Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, October 19, 2018 4:44 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Budget breakdown 
 
I'm trying to think. I'm pretty sure Al is required to talk twice at the GM Meetings, if I remember correctly, Monday and Tuesday, so perhaps I can whack Wednesday. Only thing is, there would be a change fee on the flight which I think would be more than the hotel room that night (I found a different one at $150-ish)
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, October 19, 2018 4:35:33 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Budget breakdown 
 
What are our options?
Are there any days we don’t need to be there? Honest question. Asking out of curiosity.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, October 19, 2018 4:17 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Budget breakdown
Yeah, we gotta figure something out then. Right now -- including flights to GM meetings and winter meetings -- and with switching to a cheaper hotel at GM meetings, I'm at $1,900.
That's not including the hotel for the winter meetings, because the reservation system isn't up yet, or food or other travel.
Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, October 19, 2018 4:03:45 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: RE: Budget breakdown
OK. I did some budget crunching. (We’re being asked to cut $30K in total newsroom travel in the final quarter).
I need to keep this to a max of $2,500, please.
Whatever we have to do to make that happen, let’s do it.
Let me know. We can talk about it if you need.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, October 12, 2018 7:46 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: Budget breakdown
Roughly about the same for each, though I’m not sure of the exact room rates because they’re not posted on the MLB portal yet.
$600-ish for flights - maybe there are cheaper available for the winter meetings, a month later — I’d say roughly $250 for rooms (Sun, Mon, Tues, Wed). So I’d say upwards of $3,000.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Thomas, Christopher
Sent: Friday, October 12, 2018 4:29:51 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Budget breakdown
Can you send me budgeted cost for GM meetings and winter meetings?
Thanks.
Chris Thomas
Sports editor
cdthomas@freepress.com
